screen: Production Car detail, booking awaiting installation (phone 390), stage 2 pass 2

expected_differences: The production account uses a D initial, its stored name and unread counts instead of Maya’s portrait and fixture identity.
The supplied branded-car campaign visual and separate Roastery artwork replace the Lab’s vehicle fixture. The campaign visual is not presented as installation evidence.
The actual offer is $300.00 per month, with $255.00 to the person after the stated 15% fee—not the Lab’s $240.00 offer.
Rear-window placement, 30 days, Raleigh, colour requirements and spot counts reflect this campaign’s records.
The accepted 2019 BMW 330i booking correctly shows Installation next and Paid so far: Nothing yet. Application controls are appropriately absent.
keep: The approximately 358×239px campaign image and immediately attached white caption, inset 12px on the left with a flush right edge.
Mineral canvas, square financial and booking surfaces, restrained dividers and no elevated-card dashboard treatment.
Strong ink monetary hierarchy with per month directly beneath the amount; gross, fee and recipient amount remain explicit.
Separate campaign visual, inspectable supplied artwork and named booked vehicle rather than treating them as interchangeable evidence.
Literal waiting status and concise explanation that payment follows business-confirmed installation.
Ink inspection and vehicle actions, business link, separate Save control and the unchanged four-destination navigation.
review.readiness_note: Sign off the captured 390px layout. Save persistence, inspection destinations, navigation and backend installation/payment transitions still require interaction testing; this capture establishes their visible treatment, not their execution.
review.why: This translates the approved language rather than copying the Home layout. The landscape source ends in the correct inset monthly caption; typography, mineral and white surfaces, restrained corners and navigation closely match the Lab. Longer campaign identity and fee text wrap without clipping. The booking clearly separates future installation, conditional payment and nothing paid so far, while artwork inspection, vehicle access, Save and navigation remain exposed. No visible implementation drift or release-blocking usability issue appears at this viewport.
review.verdict: Frame Shift was faithfully transferred to this Car detail screen, with the real booking state and visible functionality preserved.
